# Vi Sao Session `78993c28` Khong Phan Hoi Nua

Session `agent:coder:ws:direct:78993c28-68be-4d3f-83bd-701b8822ec1c` khong bi mat ket noi hay sap ha tang. Agent da thuc su chay xong mot run dai khoang `36.985s`, nhung no bi mac ket trong mot vong lap `list_files -> LLM -> list_files` va bi bo `tool loop detector` cua GoClaw chu dong dung lai.

Noi ngan gon: he thong khong bi chet. Agent bi "tu ket xe" trong logic suy nghi va dung tool, roi tu tra ve mot thong bao that bai: no da lap `list_files` qua nhieu lan ma khong tien trien.

## System picture

Co 5 thanh phan chinh trong session nay:

1. User gui mot cau hoi ve diem hay trong system design.
2. GoClaw UI gui yeu cau vao gateway qua websocket.
3. Agent loop cua `coder` build prompt va goi `Claude Opus 4.6`.
4. LLM tra ve tool calls.
5. Loop detector theo doi xem agent co dang lap lai cung mot tool call ma khong hoc duoc gi moi hay khong.

Dieu quan trong o case nay:

- Khong co panic backend.
- Khong co restart container.
- Khong co disconnect giua luc run dang thuc thi.
- Co loop detector can runaway tool usage.

### Cac action calls cu the

Run nay da thuc hien dung chuoi call sau:

1. `list_files({})`
2. `memory_search({"query":"system design architecture"})`
3. `vault_search({"query":"system architecture design overview"})`
4. `list_files({"path":"."})`
5. `list_files({"path":"."})`
6. `list_files({"path":"."})`
7. `list_files({"path":"."})`
8. `list_files({"path":"."})`

Nghia la sau batch dau tien, agent khong doi chien luoc nua. No khong tong hop ket qua, khong doi tool, khong chuyen sang tra loi truc tiep, ma chi tiep tuc "mo lai cung mot thu muc".

## Technical terms

`tool loop`

Day la tinh huong agent tiep tuc goi cung mot tool, voi cung argument hoac ket qua tuong duong, ma khong tao ra thong tin moi de giai bai toan.

`loop detector`

Day la co che bao ve cua GoClaw. No khong de agent goi tool vo han. Khi thay cung mot pattern lap lai nhieu lan, no chen warning; den nguong `critical`, no ket thuc run.

`run completed`

Trang thai nay co nghia la run da ket thuc co kiem soat. No khac voi `panic`, `timeout`, hay `container restart`.

`khong phan hoi nua`

Trong case nay, cam giac "khong phan hoi nua" den tu viec agent bi mac trong vong lap trong ~37 giay, roi ket thuc bang mot reply that bai. No khong phai do he thong dang doi mai ma khong xu ly gi.

## What this means in practice

- Nguyen nhan goc la hanh vi suy nghi/tool-usage cua agent `coder`, khong phai loi ha tang.
- Bang chung log cho thay khong co restart container va khong co disconnect giua run.
- Session nay thuc ra **co phan hoi cuoi cung**; DB luu `20` messages va UI production hien duoc lai day du sau khi hydrate xong.
- Warning `semantic: extraction failed` xuat hien sau khi run da xong, trong pha consolidation/KG; day la viec nen, khong phai ly do session ngung tra loi.

Takeaway thuc te:

- Neu muon agent thoat duoc case nay, can sua prompt/tool policy de khi `memory_search` va `vault_search` rong thi agent phai tong hop kien thuc san co va tra loi truc tiep, thay vi spam `list_files`.
- Tool loop detector da lam dung viec: no chan runaway loop va tra ve mot ket qua that bai co kiem soat, thay vi de session treo mai.
